ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the upper part is a fixed crossbeam, and a thin string vertically downward suspends the small object B above; B is in close contact with the wider object A below. A is above a vertical light spring, and the lower end of the spring is fixed on a ground support; the whole is a vertical-direction structure. Reasoning: The problem gives m_A=4kg, m_B=1kg, g=10m/s^2. Before the string is cut, A is at rest, and there is no pressure between A and B, so the spring only bears the gravity of A, and the spring elastic force F_s=m_Ag=4×10=40N. At the instant the string is cut, the spring deformation has no time to change, so the spring elastic force is still 40N. Let the common downward acceleration of A and B at the instant the string is cut be a, and the pressure of B on A be N. For the forces on A: the gravity of A, 40N, is downward, and the spring elastic force, 40N, is upward; the two cancel, and the remaining pressure N of B on A makes A accelerate downward, so N=m_Aa=4a. For the forces on B: gravity m_Bg=10N is downward, and the supporting force N of A on B is upward, so m_Ba=m_Bg-N, that is, a=10-N. Combining N=4a and a=10-N gives 4a=10-a, 5a=10, a=2m/s^2, therefore N=4a=8N.

method.method_draft: 先从图中确认竖直结构：A在下方压在竖直轻弹簧上，B在A上方并由竖直细线悬挂，剪线后B会与A沿竖直方向接触并共同运动。由题文读出m_A=4kg、m_B=1kg、初始A静止且A、B间无压力、g=10m/s^2。初始因A、B间无压力，弹簧弹力只平衡A的重力，所以剪断瞬间弹簧形变量未变，弹簧力仍为F_s=m_A g=40N。剪断后设A、B共同向下加速度为a，B对A的压力为N。对A列式：m_A a=N，因为弹簧力40N与A重力40N抵消，只剩B的压力使A向下加速；对B列式：m_B a=m_B g-N。联立得4a=10-N，且N=4a，故5a=10，a=2m/s^2，N=8N。
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中上方是固定横梁，细线竖直向下悬挂着上方小物体B；B与下方较宽的物体A紧挨接触。A在竖直轻弹簧上方，弹簧下端固定在地面支座上，整体为竖直方向结构。
推理：题给m_A=4kg，m_B=1kg，g=10m/s^2。剪线前A静止，且A、B之间无压力，所以弹簧只承受A的重力，弹簧弹力F_s=m_Ag=4×10=40N。剪断瞬间，弹簧形变量来不及改变，因此弹簧弹力仍为40N。设剪断瞬间A、B共同向下加速度为a，B对A的压力为N。对A受力：A重力40N向下，弹簧弹力40N向上，二者抵消，剩下B对A的压力N使A向下加速，所以N=m_Aa=4a。对B受力：重力m_Bg=10N向下，A对B支持力N向上，所以m_Ba=m_Bg-N，即a=10-N。联立N=4a和a=10-N，得4a=10-a，5a=10，a=2m/s^2，因此N=4a=8N。
